Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce Get Married at NYC's Madison Square Garden

Celebrity couple Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce tied the knot at a private ceremony at Madison Square Garden in New York City. The event was attended by numerous A-list celebrities, including Adam Sandler, who officiated the wedding. The White House also shared an AI-generated parody message on social media, reigniting public friction between Trump and Swift.
